general_information.Description: This comprehensive Basic Unity Training Program is designed to equip participants with essential skills in Unity game development, empowering them to create engaging and interactive 2D and 3D games. Building upon strong foundation in C# programming, the course delves into advanced topics such as 3D game development, physics, animations, and user interface design. Through a combination of theoretical lectures, hands-on labs, and collaborative projects, participants will gain practical experience and confidence in using Unity to bring their game ideas to life. Key Learning Outcomes: - Master C# Programming: Gain a deep understanding of C# syntax, data structures, algorithms, and object-oriented programming principles. - Navigate the Unity Environment: Become proficient in using Unity's interface and tools for game development. - Develop 3D Games: Learn the fundamentals of 3D game development, including rendering, lighting, animations, and physics. - Create Engaging Game Worlds: Master the art of designing game objects, animations, and physics components to create immersive and interactive game environments. - Build User-Friendly Interfaces: Design intuitive and visually appealing user interfaces that enhance the player experience. - Develop Games from Start to Finish: Complete hands-on projects, applying your knowledge to create your own small games and interactive applications. - Collaborate Effectively: Work collaboratively with teammates to develop game projects, fostering effective communication and teamwork skills.
general_information.StudentTasks: - Students must attend at least 80% of contact slots in order to be accepted to the final examination. - Student is responsible to do all exercises, assignments and labs given by instructor in class or at home and submit on time - Use laptop in class only for learning purpose - Promptly access to http://flm.fpt.edu.vn for up-to-date course information
general_information.Tools: - Internet - Visual Studio 2019 or later (C# programming language) - Unity Hub and Unity 5 (version 2021.3 LTS or later) - Minimum hardware requirement: Windows 10, 64-bit versions, CPU: X64, RAM: 8GB - Students use Unity with their personal email for educational purposes only

learning_outcomes.CLO Details: Understand C# Programming Fundamentals: Syntax and Data Types, Control Flow, Functions and Methods, Classes and Objects, Debugging
Understand C# data structures (lists, stacks, queues, trees) and algorithms (sorting, searching); Event Handling
Understand the Unity interface and basic tools for game development
Understand 3D Game Development; Rendering and Lighting; Animations and Physics
Create and manipulate game objects, animations, and physics components
Design user interfaces and handle user input effectively
Develop small games and interactive applications using Unity
Collaborate effectively in a team environment for game development projects.
